# LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends — concept pack (small)

> 12 source-anchored research claims on LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends, grouped by facet. Original confidence and source-owner limits are retained.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-09-30 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Definitions

- [fact] Native tool support is a model/backend capability. Ollama exposes tools and structured tool_calls; LiteLLM's documentation warns that not every Ollama model supports function calling. — https://docs.ollama.com/api/chat · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/ollama
- [statement] Use ollama_chat/<model> for Ollama POST /api/chat; LiteLLM recommends that path rather than legacy ollama/<model> for conversational responses. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/ollama

## How it works

- [statement] At the pinned commit, the Ollama Chat adapter forwards native tools directly and sets finish_reason=tool_calls when structured calls appear, including streamed calls. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/llms/ollama/chat/transformation.py

## Parameters and configuration

- [fact] Native Ollama api_base points at the server root, such as http://localhost:11434. OpenAI-compatible calls need the backend's API root, commonly ending in /v1, not a full operation URL. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/openai_compatible · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://docs.ollama.com/api/openai-compatibility, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/ollama
- [statement] vLLM automatic tool selection requires --enable-auto-tool-choice, a compatible --tool-call-parser and a tool-compatible chat template. The --chat-template argument is optional when tokenizer_config.json already supplies a suitable template. The cited Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct quickstart uses llama3_json and examples/tool_chat_template_llama3.1_json.jinja; those choices are specific to that example. Enabling an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint alone does not configure these model-specific requirements. — https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/tool_calling/
- [statement] For Anthropic clients on a chat-only openai/ backend, opt into the Messages-to-Chat path. For clients sending Responses requests, use_chat_completions_api controls a separate Responses-to-Chat bridge. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/config_settings · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/response_api
- [fact] Ollama's OpenAI interface has no standard context-size control. Configure context through a Modelfile alias; native Ollama options such as num_ctx belong to a different API path. — https://docs.ollama.com/api/openai-compatibility · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/llms/ollama/chat/transformation.py

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] For native Ollama streaming, accumulate thinking, content, and tool_calls and replay the complete assistant turn with tool results in the next request; processing text alone loses tool state. — https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/tool-calling
- [fact] For a generic OpenAI-compatible Chat target, configure openai/<upstream-model>, its api_base, and an upstream API key or required placeholder; gateway and upstream credentials are separate settings. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/openai_compatible · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/openai-python/main/README.md
- [fact] Engineering validation should cover schemas, call/result pairing, parallel calls, streamed argument assembly, and follow-up turns. These are separate protocol obligations, not satisfied by a text-only smoke test. — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/handle-tool-calls · keywords: LiteLLM local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends · also: https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/tool-calling, https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/online_serving/openai_compatible_server/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The pinned native Ollama Chat adapter removes tool_choice rather than enforcing it. Do not rely on forced named, required, or none behavior through this path without validation. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/llms/ollama/chat/transformation.py
- [statement] Schema-constrained output can produce a parseable tool call without a good task decision. Validate semantic arguments and useful tool selection before treating a backend as research-capable. — https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/tool_calling/
